messages:
Alex: ran a couple of nsys traces on the latest dynamic-kernel-selector change, seeing a lot of tiny kernel launches and high KV cache miss tail. attaching quick summary below
Alex: nsys summary: GPU time 1203ms, kernels=48, top kernel matmul_fp16: 52%, kernel_launch_latency_spikes at dispatch boundaries
Dinesh: hmm, that sounds like kernel churn from selector fallback. did you correlate with NVTX ranges?
Alex: yes — but current NVTX spans are per-op and use long names. it's hard to find request-level grouping in the profile.
Maria: we should add a parent per-request span + short child kernel spans. keep names compact and machine-parseable. example suggestion: parent: rt:req:id=<rid> model=<m> seq=<s> bs=<b> child: rt:kernel:<kshort>:v<X>
Sam: agree. also include a short numeric tag for kernel variant so kernel timeline labels don't explode. humans can map numbers to names via a legend file.
Dinesh: +1. but watch instrumentation overhead — nvtxRangePush per small kernel can change timing. maybe sample or enable only in debug runs.
Alex: prototype NVTX snippet that worked for me:
```cpp
// C++ helper (low-overhead formatting)
if (nvtx_enabled) {
  char buf[64];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "rt:req:%d m=%s s=%d b=%d", req_id, model_tag, seq_len, batch_size);
  nvtxRangePushA(buf);
}
```
Maria: and Python wrapper (for micro-batching layer):
```python
if os.getenv('NVTX_ON') == '1':
    nvtx.range_push(f"rt:req:{rid} m={m} s={s} b={b}")
```
Dinesh: naming rules proposal: 1) prefix with "rt" 2) request parent span: "rt:req:<short-id>" (short-id = last 6 digits) 3) kernel child: "rt:k:<KID>:p=X" where KID is small numeric id and p = policy variant 4) no spaces except '=' 5) include seq/bs only on parent
Alex: sounds good. also add build-time flag to map KID -> human name for trace legends. store mapping in /perf/legend.json in CI artifacts.
Sam: what about KV cache events? we should mark cache hits/misses for prefetch and lookup as separate NVTX markers (instant events) so perf timeline can correlate stalls. e.g., nvtx1: "rt:kv:hit" / "rt:kv:miss" with extra attr for key_hash short
Dinesh: yeah, use nvtxDomain_t and nvtxEventAttributes to set color/category for quick glance. but keep the message string tiny.
PerfBot: reminder: nvtx strings > 64 bytes can be truncated in some profilers. prefer IDs + legend for anything verbose.
Maria: operational rules: default instrumentation off in CI perf collection; enable with PERF_NVTX=1 for targeted runs. add time budget check: if request time < 200us, skip per-kernel NVTX to avoid perturbation.
Alex: next steps: I'll add parent span at scheduler entry and child kernel spans inside kernel-dispatch. Dinesh can prototype KID mapper. Maria will update perf docs with the naming convention.
Sam: if we do this, we can correlate kernel selection churn with KV miss stamp and see where batching heuristics break.
Dinesh: I'll also post an example perfetto timeline after changes. thanks all :thumbsup:
